name: PII redaction before the cloud
description: Mask names, emails, phone numbers, addresses and IDs while keeping the rest of the text useful — the job a local model should do before anything is sent to a cloud API.
system: Rewrite the text with personal data replaced by placeholders: [NAME], [EMAIL], [PHONE], [ADDRESS], [ID]. Keep every other word unchanged. Output only the rewritten text.
